text:
nora-infra: Vendor flagged 4x A100-80GB DOA at FRA DC, hold at origin. They want RMA confirmation before sending replacements. Need ETA on standbys and cost exposure.

 tom-ops: Ugh. Which vendor... NexaSupply?

 ivan-vendor: Hi all — yes NexaSupply here. Confirmed 4 DOAs (serials in next msg). We can split: 2 immediate crossdock replacements + 2 repair-to-replace (ETA 10 business days). Expedited freight available for all 4 for €420 total + dock fees at receiving hub (~€150). We can credit diagnostics fee and offer 3-day standby credit per unit on monthly invoice if you take split delivery.

 elaine-logistics: @ivan-vendor drop the AWBs and the courier. Also, customs needs a proforma showing 'replacement units under warranty' to avoid duty; can you supply?

 ivan-vendor: Sure. AWBs:
 ```
 AWB: 476-882-992
 AWB: 476-882-993
 AWB: 476-882-994
 AWB: 476-882-995
 RMA cases: RMA-9901 RMA-9902 RMA-9903 RMA-9904
 ```
 Proforma will be uploaded to the portal in 30m.

 nora-infra: If we accept split delivery, can we request 1-week standby pool from you while repairs complete? We need to avoid capacity impact in eu-west-1.

 ivan-vendor: We can provide 2 standby units from stock for up to 7 days at no charge if you commit to expedited return of DOAs and provide BOL within 48h. Additional standby beyond 7 days is billable at daily rate €35/unit.

 tom-ops: Confirming warranty terms: vendor covers DOA replacement & diagnostics. Who pays dock fee if customs flags additional handling?

 ivan-vendor: We'll absorb the receiving dock fee up to €150 if the shipment clears with our proforma and you sign the expedited amendment. Customs brokerage beyond basic docs is on Redwood unless broker flags issues caused by incorrect declarations.

 rma-bot: New ticket created: RMA-9901..9904. Status: awaiting customer approval for expedited amendment. Link: https://rma.nexasupply.example/tickets/RMA-9901

 elaine-logistics: Note: FRA DC has limited crossdock slots today — if we don't book by 16:00 CET, earliest arrival moves to Monday and courier surcharge applies.

 nora-infra: I approve split delivery + expedited amendment. Please send the amendment PDF and an itemized invoice showing the dock fee credit and standby credit terms. I'll sign before 16:00 CET.

 ivan-vendor: Sending amendment now. Invoice shows:
 - Expedited freight: €420
 - Dock fee: €150 (credited)
 - Standby credit: -€210 (3 days × 2 units @ €35)
 Net due now: €420 (expedite) — we'll apply standby credit on next monthly statement.

 tom-ops: Thanks. @elaine-logistics book crossdock slot for 15:30 CET pickup window. Also update capacity plan to borrow 2 spare units from staging pool in eu-west-1 for 72h as contingency.

 elaine-logistics: Slot booked. Courier ETD 15:30 CET. Documents received and uploaded.

 nora-infra: Great — keep me posted on delivery and RMA progression. If customs pushes any additional fees, capture receipts; we'll decide on quick remit vs challenge later.

 ivan-vendor: Acknowledged. We'll mark RMA tickets as 'in-transit' once AWBs scan out. Thanks :handshake:
